name: samantha-social-desk-chat-pilot
description: Local reel review and offline mock drafts inside ordinary Claude Desktop Chat.

pilot_mode.title: Offline pilot mode
pilot_mode.description: Leave off for previews only. Enter mock for synthetic drafts or mock-timeout for synthetic recovery testing. No live mode exists.

approved_folder.title: Approved reel review folder (optional)
approved_folder.description: One read-only folder. Cover and caption requested in Chat are shared with Claude; no video bytes are transmitted.

approval_probe.title: Optional native approval probe
approval_probe.description: Enter on for the synthetic no-write approval probe. Leave off normally.
